title.narrative: In 2024, the One Million Opportunities (1MiO) initiative, carried out by UNICEF Brazil in the context of the global Generation Unlimited (GenU) program, reached the milestone of 402,057 opportunities generated for professional training and access to decent work. Of these, 311,282 opportunities (apprenticeship, internship and formal employment) were filled by young people aged between 14 and 29 and were in vulnerable situation. And 90,775 young people were trained in 40 courses, in different formats. UNICEF worked through coordination with the private sector and local governments.
